Cause: the desktop properties panel (packages/excalidraw/components/Actions.tsx:189, not editable in this run) renders `renderAction("changeArrowhead")` directly; only the compact popover renders `changeArrowProperties`, so the new size control never appears where the arrowhead pickers show on desktop (AC-4: the control must show wherever the arrowhead pickers show). Fix in this file only: (1) change actionChangeArrowhead's PanelComponent signature to `({ elements, appState, updateData, app, renderAction })` and render `{renderAction("changeArrowheadSize")}` right after its closing `</fieldset>` (wrap both in a React fragment `<>...</>` so the component returns one root); (2) remove the `{renderAction("changeArrowheadSize")}` line from actionChangeArrowProperties' PanelComponent (it now comes with changeArrowhead, so the compact popover would otherwise show it twice). Keep everything else unchanged, including the RadioSelection testIds arrowheadSize-small/-medium/-large/-veryLarge.

instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Two failures in the test itself (the source behaves correctly): (1) `propagates currentItemArrowheadSize ...` -> `AssertionError: expected 1 to be 0.5` at arrowheadSize.test.tsx:185: `h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeArrowheadSize, "ui", ARROWHEAD_SIZES.sm)` is called outside React's act(), so h.state has not updated when it is read. Wrap the call: `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeArrowheadSize, "ui", ARROWHEAD_SIZES.sm); });` and import `act` from "./test-utils" (it is re-exported there, as other tests such as lasso.test.tsx use it); do the same for any other direct executeAction call in this file. (2) `restores an arrow with arrowheadSize 0.5 and exports a smaller SVG head path ...` -> `expected 11.75 to be close to 11.745000000000005, received difference is 0.0049999999999954525, but expected 0.0005` at arrowheadSize.test.tsx:341: SVG path coordinates are rounded to 2 decimals, so `toBeCloseTo(..., 3)` is too strict. Use precision 1 for the spanX and spanY toBeCloseTo checks (the toBeLessThan checks stay). The other three failing tests (`Unable to find ... arrowheadSize-small`) are fixed in actionProperties.tsx by the same round; do not change those tests' expectations. Keep the five tests and their intent.
